definitions.explanation: A game or activity where one shoots at targets, especially the cork-gun shooting stalls found at Japanese festivals and hot spring towns.

examples.japanese: お{祭|まつ}りで{射的|しゃてき}をした。
examples.english: I played the shooting gallery at the festival.

examples.japanese: {射的|しゃてき}で{大|おお}きな{景品|けいひん}を{当|あ}てた。
examples.english: I won a big prize at the shooting gallery.

examples.japanese: {子供|こども}のころ、{温泉|おんせん}{街|がい}の{射的|しゃてき}{屋|や}に{行|い}くのが{楽|たの}しみだった。
examples.english: When I was a child, I looked forward to going to the shooting gallery in the hot spring town.

notes:
In Japan, {射的|しゃてき} most commonly refers to the cork-gun shooting game found at summer festivals ({夏祭|なつまつ}り), shrine festivals, and {温泉|おんせん}{街|がい} (hot spring towns). Players use a cork gun to try to knock down prizes displayed on shelves. It is a nostalgic pastime associated with traditional Japanese entertainment.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {射的|しゃてき}{屋|や}: shooting gallery stall
- {射的|しゃてき}をする: to play the shooting game
- {射的|しゃてき}{場|じょう}: shooting range
- {射的|しゃてき}の{景品|けいひん}: shooting gallery prizes

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {的当|まとあ}て: target game — a broader term for any hit-the-target game
- {射撃|しゃげき}: shooting — the serious sport or military activity, not a game
